content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clearwater

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Verify your credentials meet PMI's standards before enrolling. Granite PM Academy can guide you through this assessment at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Sessions are scheduled flexibly to fit working professionals' calendars across multiple time zones. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application through interactive lessons and Q&A with active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your contact hours, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the exam registration fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers targeted exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and final review sessions to reinforce critical concepts. You'll take the PMP exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer last-minute questions before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) over PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle through training, volunteer work, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and workshops to support your continuous learning and credential maintenance.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
